forecasts.name: Climate Pessimist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: West African cocoa stands cannot withstand recurring temperature anomalies. Depleted inventories and erratic rains will reignite the surge over $6,807.

forecasts.name: Land-Grab Realist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: West African structural crop decay cannot quickly recover. Processors bear the cost burden of inelastic physical supply despite retail pushback.

forecasts.name: BirdLife Europe, EEB, WWF and Greenpeace (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Cocoa monocultures in West Africa are suffering systemic disease and climatic degradation, leaving global supply perpetually fragile.

forecasts.name: Macro / Dollar · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Cocoa rebounded aggressively from spring lows alongside macro tailwinds. Speculative fund participation keeps an upside push toward $6,807 viable.

forecasts.name: Crowd Follower · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Market sits at 32%. Cocoa prices paused and ticked down slightly in September, keeping us closely pegged to the market consensus.

forecasts.name: Geopolitics Hawk · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Consumer price pushback and confectionery demand destruction cap extreme rallies, even amidst ongoing West African structural fragility.

forecasts.name: FAO (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Consumer price resistance and confectionery demand destruction in major import markets dampen further bullish momentum above $6,800.

forecasts.name: IMF (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Emerging demand destruction and retail pushback across confectionery markets cap substantial further upside rallies above $6,800/mt.

forecasts.name: Copa-Cogeca (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Consumer pushback against chocolate price hikes is triggering demand destruction, putting a ceiling on wholesale cocoa rallies.

forecasts.name: IFPRI (Joseph Glauber) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Confectionery manufacturers are facing consumer resistance against retail price hikes; demand destruction dampens wholesale cocoa upside beyond $6,807/mt.

forecasts.name: European Commission DG AGRI (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Clear signs of confectionery demand destruction and consumer price pushback dampen further upside momentum.

forecasts.name: USDA WASDE (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Mounting evidence of consumer demand destruction and confectionery margin squeeze limits upside follow-through above $6,807/mt.

forecasts.name: Scott Irwin (farmdoc) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Demand destruction is clearly showing up in processor earnings. Post-boom cocoa prices are settling lower, capping upside runs.

forecasts.name: Agronomist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: West Africa's main crop harvest enters peak arrival from October to January. Swelling bean arrivals and consumer demand resistance make a rally above $6,807 improbable.

forecasts.name: Adaptation Optimist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Elevated cocoa prices have already triggered demand destruction and heavy investment in farm rejuvenation, capping rallies.

forecasts.name: Efficient-Market Skeptic · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Cocoa's bounce to $5,900 is meeting fierce consumer pushback and demand destruction. Sustained momentum beyond $6,800 is an extreme scenario worth fading.
